title: C: receiver-owned rendezvous state
description:
Extend lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link_ctx.h and lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_rx.c with authenticated receiver context. Retain full receiver/root/DODAG identity, shared generation, identified plan/version, permitted global indices, home channel/profile and expiry. Local permission checks cannot substitute another subset or retune the receiver in response to density, CCA or sender replay-epoch changes.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing authentication and peer-context boundaries; do not build a parallel identity database. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil derivation and radio-owned keys, baseline SCHC/security and best-effort custody. Key portability is deferred and audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals are out of scope. This task authorizes no hardware access, RF operation or guessed new wire semantics; zephyr.02 supplies the codec.
acceptance_criteria: Use vectors.02/.03 through production Announce/RX adoption and selection. Test direct versus relayed origin, actual immediate next hop, receiver versus sender identity/generation, sparse masks, stale replacement, expiry, bounded storage and unsupported home channel. Assert correct physical frequency or suppressed TX, not only an in-range index. Extend lichen/tests/routing_announce and lichen/tests/routing_dispatch with host/native cases; run sanitizers/lint and TDMA-enabled native_sim on local Linux/heft with the verified current west pin.
